data.name: Iqra
data.gender_notes: Iqra is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Iqra is a meaningful Arabic name derived from the Quranic command 'Read'. It symbolizes knowledge, education, and enlightenment. The name Iqra carries the meaning “Read, Recite, Learn” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Iqra usually hope their child will grow to embody read, recite, learn and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the pursuit of knowledge and the importance of reading and learning as a spiritual duty.
data.etymology: Iqra belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Read, Recite, Learn.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Iqra total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_english.name: Iqra
in_english.long_meaning: To read and recite the verses of the Quran; To learn and gain knowledge

data.cultural_impact: The name Iqra holds significant cultural importance, as it is a reminder of the important role of literacy and education in Islamic tradition. This name was given to the Prophet Muhammad's beloved daughter Fatima, symbolizing the importance of knowledge and learning in the religious and cultural context of Islam.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Iqra holds deep spiritual significance, as it is a direct command from Allah in the Quran (96:1), emphasizing the importance of seeking knowledge and reading the Sacred Text. It also serves as a reminder of the oneness of God and the importance of striving for knowledge as a means to come closer to Him.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Iqra: "Read!" This name is a command from Allah to Prophet Muhammad, signifying the beginning of revelation and the importance of knowledge and education.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Iqra is mentioned in Islamic tradition as the first word revealed to Prophet Muhammad The name Iqra carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The name is associated with the beginning of the Quranic revelation, signifying the command to 'read' or 'recite'

trends: used in both Islamic and secular contexts
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Iqra remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
